notes: Business actions for /sc4sap:assist, executed only through ZMCP_BIZ_EXECUTE on the SAP side.
Draft 2026-11-09: interface and source checked on ECC740-DEV only; S4-DEV and ECC731-DEV pending.
testrun CHECK_FM = a separate check FM (check_fm) runs the same checks without posting; CHECK_ONLY = the same FM with a check-only flag; none = preview from facts and biz-rules.
Customer validations / substitutions (GGB) are system specific and live in biz-rules/FI.json of the profile, not in this catalog.

actions.title: Show an accounting document (header, lines, status, reversal link)

ECC.note: RFC-enabled read by document number or object key; returns header and lines in the BKPF / BSEG structures to the caller only; party names are not requested

S4.note: RFC-enabled read by document number or object key; returns header and lines in the BKPF / BSEG structures to the caller only; party names are not requested

actions.title: List open items of a G/L account (open-item managed accounts)

clarify.ask: Open items as of which key date? Today, or another date?
Which G/L account? (The account must be open-item managed.)

ECC.note: no standard read FM fits a chatbot (FAGL_GET_OPEN_ITEMS_GL is a migration helper); handler reads BSIS by company code, account and key date; amounts only, no party master data

S4.note: ACDOCA with open-item flag (XOPVW) on S/4; to be re-verified on the S/4 system

actions.title: Show a G/L account of a company code (type, currency, field status group, block flags)
Post a G/L journal entry (accrual, reclass, correction)

params.name: lines
params.note: each line: name=value pairs separated by ; (account, amount (+ debit, - credit, document currency), cost_center, order, profit_center, text, tax_code, business_area, assignment), values percent-encoded for % ; =

params.name: fis_period
params.description: Posting period, e.g. 13-16 for closing postings in a special period; empty = from the posting date

clarify.ask: Which posting date? The period of that date must be open.
Which document type? (for example SA for a general journal entry)
Which accounts and amounts? A journal entry needs balanced debit and credit lines.
clarify.when: lines are missing or do not balance

clarify.ask: This account needs a cost center or order. Which one?
clarify.when: the account field status requires a cost object and none is given

clarify.ask: The currency differs from the company code currency. Use the table rate of the posting date, or enter a rate?
clarify.when: currency differs from the local currency

ECC.set: DOCUMENTHEADER (COMP_CODE, DOC_TYPE, PSTNG_DATE, DOC_DATE, HEADER_TXT, REF_DOC_NO) + ACCOUNTGL + CURRENCYAMOUNT (+ ACCOUNTTAX)
ECC.preview: BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_CHECK with the same tables (the CHECK never posts): runs the AC-interface checks, field status, number range and the customer validations of the check path (a user-bound closing-date validation and an exchange-rate validation were reached on the test system); it does not return text substitutions. Plus the static rules of biz-rules/FI.json for what the check does not reach.
ECC.note: CHECK never posts; the document number is returned only by POST (OBJ_KEY). Substitutions may change lines: show the substituted lines from the CHECK result tables before EXECUTE.

S4.set: DOCUMENTHEADER (COMP_CODE, DOC_TYPE, PSTNG_DATE, DOC_DATE, HEADER_TXT, REF_DOC_NO) + ACCOUNTGL + CURRENCYAMOUNT (+ ACCOUNTTAX)
S4.preview: BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_CHECK with the same tables (the CHECK never posts): runs the AC-interface checks, field status, number range and the customer validations of the check path (a user-bound closing-date validation and an exchange-rate validation were reached on the test system); it does not return text substitutions. Plus the static rules of biz-rules/FI.json for what the check does not reach.
S4.note: CHECK never posts; the document number is returned only by POST (OBJ_KEY). Substitutions may change lines: show the substituted lines from the CHECK result tables before EXECUTE.

en: The check does not return values set by substitution (for example texts); they appear in the posted document.
Authorization and customer checks that run only at save can still refuse the change at execute.
ko: 체크는 대체(substitution)로 바뀌는 값(예: 텍스트)을 돌려주지 않아요. 전기된 전표에서만 보여요.
저장할 때만 도는 권한 체크와 고객 체크는 실행할 때 거절할 수 있어요.

ambiguity.ask: Do you want to reverse the posted document (a new reversal document is posted)?

clarify.ask: Which reversal reason? (it decides whether the reversal posts in the original period or in the posting-date period)
Which posting date for the reversal document? Same period as the original, or the next period?

ECC.set: REVERSAL (OBJ_TYPE = origin of the document from BKPF-AWTYP, OBJ_KEY, OBJ_KEY_R, PSTNG_DATE, FIS_PERIOD, COMP_CODE, REASON_REV) + BUS_ACT RFBU
ECC.preview: static checks of the handler (document exists, not already reversed, reason in T041C) + BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_REV_CHECK (AC_DOCUMENT_REVERSE: reversibility, period, number range)
ECC.note: REV_CHECK refuses documents posted in dialog (origin BKPF) and documents whose reversal document type has no number range; the reversal posting date must not be smaller than the original posting date; whether REV_CHECK reaches the document-level customer validations is not confirmed

S4.set: REVERSAL (OBJ_TYPE = origin of the document from BKPF-AWTYP, OBJ_KEY, OBJ_KEY_R, PSTNG_DATE, FIS_PERIOD, COMP_CODE, REASON_REV) + BUS_ACT RFBU
S4.preview: static checks of the handler (document exists, not already reversed, reason in T041C) + BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_REV_CHECK (AC_DOCUMENT_REVERSE: reversibility, period, number range)
S4.note: REV_CHECK refuses documents posted in dialog (origin BKPF) and documents whose reversal document type has no number range; the reversal posting date must not be smaller than the original posting date; whether REV_CHECK reaches the document-level customer validations is not confirmed

en: The reversal check stops at the first error; later checks (such as the closing date) show only after that error is fixed.
Authorization and customer checks that run only at save can still refuse the change at execute.
ko: 역분개 체크는 첫 오류에서 멈춰요. 마감일 같은 뒤쪽 체크는 그 오류를 고친 뒤에야 드러나요.
저장할 때만 도는 권한 체크와 고객 체크는 실행할 때 거절할 수 있어요.

actions.title: Set or remove the payment block key of an open vendor line item

params.name: block_key
params.note: a payment block key (1 character), or - to remove the block; blank is refused

clarify.ask: Which payment block key? Answer - to remove the block.
The document has several open vendor lines. Which line item?
clarify.when: more than one open vendor line

ECC.set: FB02 batch input of the line: field ZLSPR = block key, after FI_DOCUMENT_READ confirmed that the line is an open vendor or customer line and T008 holds the block key
ECC.preview: no check mode: preview = static (FI_DOCUMENT_READ: line open, vendor or customer line, current block; T008: block key exists) + biz-rules/FI.json. EXECUTE runs all FB02 validations, so a customer validation can refuse a change that the preview accepts (PREVIEW_GAP).
ECC.note: FI_DOCUMENT_CHANGE would skip the FB02 validations; BAPI_ACC_PYMNTBLK_UPDATE_* changes only the cash-discount day offset of an invoice reference, not the block key.

S4.set: FB02 batch input of the line: field ZLSPR = block key, after FI_DOCUMENT_READ confirmed that the line is an open vendor or customer line and T008 holds the block key
S4.preview: no check mode: preview = static (FI_DOCUMENT_READ: line open, vendor or customer line, current block; T008: block key exists) + biz-rules/FI.json. EXECUTE runs all FB02 validations, so a customer validation can refuse a change that the preview accepts (PREVIEW_GAP).
S4.note: FI_DOCUMENT_CHANGE would skip the FB02 validations; BAPI_ACC_PYMNTBLK_UPDATE_* changes only the cash-discount day offset of an invoice reference, not the block key.

en: No check mode: document-change validations run only at execute.
Authorization and customer checks that run only at save can still refuse the change at execute.
ko: 체크 모드가 없어요. 전표 변경 검증은 실행할 때만 돌아요.
저장할 때만 도는 권한 체크와 고객 체크는 실행할 때 거절할 수 있어요.

actions.title: Change the text of a document line item

params.name: text
params.note: new line item text, up to 50 characters; an empty text is refused (clearing a text is not offered)

ECC.set: T_ACCCHG (FDNAME SGTXT, NEWVAL) with I_BUKRS / I_BELNR / I_GJAHR / I_BUZEI
ECC.preview: no check mode: preview = FI_DOCUMENT_READ (line exists, current text) + the field is allowed to change + biz-rules/FI.json text rules
ECC.note: FI_DOCUMENT_CHANGE runs no document validation and no customer check: the preview and the result say so; the text is limited to the 50 characters of SGTXT

S4.set: T_ACCCHG (FDNAME SGTXT, NEWVAL) with I_BUKRS / I_BELNR / I_GJAHR / I_BUZEI
S4.preview: no check mode: preview = FI_DOCUMENT_READ (line exists, current text) + the field is allowed to change + biz-rules/FI.json text rules
S4.note: FI_DOCUMENT_CHANGE runs no document validation and no customer check: the preview and the result say so; the text is limited to the 50 characters of SGTXT

en: The change does not run document validations at all: the text is changed without them.
Authorization and customer checks that run only at save can still refuse the change at execute.
ko: 이 변경은 전표 검증을 전혀 거치지 않아요. 검증 없이 텍스트가 바뀌어요.
저장할 때만 도는 권한 체크와 고객 체크는 실행할 때 거절할 수 있어요.

actions.title: Show whether the FI posting period of a date is open, per account type (T001B)
rules: period from FI_PERIOD_DETERMINE; T001B rows of the posting period variant T001-OPVAR; open = in interval 1 or 2

actions.title: Show the credit limit, exposure and credit block of a customer (classic credit management)
rules: credit control area T001-KKBER; KNKK limit, receivables SKFOR, special liabilities SSOBL; open orders S066-OEIKW; open deliveries / billing S067-OLIKW / OFAKW
BAPI_CREDIT_ACCOUNT_GET_STATUS fails with FN 550 on some systems: not used

S4.later: S/4 uses FSCM credit management (UKM_*): separate implementation needed
